note: site header -- renders the operator's fixed logo, account controls, utility controls, and navigation vocabulary
destination search label -- renders the fixed operator vocabulary for the destination field
occupancy field label -- renders the fixed operator vocabulary for guest and room selection
search submit control -- renders the fixed search-action vocabulary
search options panel -- renders fixed operator-defined search-option labels and controls, not a results filter or refinement panel
unique selling points section -- renders the operator's fixed benefit headings and explanatory copy
property-type carousel headings -- render the operator-defined property-type vocabulary
property-type carousel control -- renders the fixed operator carousel navigation action
interlinking section heading -- renders the fixed operator section label
interlinking tab controls -- render the fixed operator tab vocabulary
footer inline navigation -- renders the operator's fixed footer-link vocabulary
footer link groups -- render the operator's fixed footer headings and navigation vocabulary
footer controls and legal area -- renders fixed operator controls, copyright copy, and service marks
